title: A tier's Audit Log records its life and customer names
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, named for example Fleet.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the tier name at the top of the page.
  4. Type a new name (for example Fleet Plus).
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Click the Customers tab.
  7. Click Manage Customers.
  8. Tick customer A.
  9. Click Add 1 Customer.
  10. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  11. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name becomes editable.

Step 4:

  • The new name shows.

Step 5:

  • The title shows the new name.

Step 6:

  • The Customers tab shows.

Step 7:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 8:

  • Customer A is ticked.

Step 9:

  • Customer A is added.

Step 10:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 11:

  • The log lists, newest first, a customer event, then "Tier Renamed", then "Tier Created".
  • The customer event names customer A.
  • The rename entry shows the old name, an arrow and the new name.
